table.name: TLGNC_TRUCK_TRAILER_HISTORY
table.description: History of the truck-trailer assignments. The most recent one schould be the same as contained in TLGNC_TRUCK.CURRENT_TRAILER_ID. TODO ADN: Is this table still needed? Could the same info also be retrieved from tlgnc_bizevent?

column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. The Truck to which a Trailer is/was assigned.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_TS
column.description: Date and Time when the trailer was assigned to the truck. TODO: This could/should be renamed to event_ts, because if information is received from PDA, it corresponds to bizevent.event_ts actually. If done in application: ctl_cre_ts = assignment_ts.
